basis_statement: Packets remain transport-only evidence derived from durable source truth. Duplicate meaning, request hash, idempotency, retry posture, and quarantine posture live on persisted outbox and inbox records rather than on broker-local delivery history.

message_family_rows.transport_boundary: HTTP acceptance may emit a packet, but request identity remains bound to the receipt and command journal.
notes: Safe retries with the same sealed command meaning must reuse duplicate meaning and idempotency even if a fresh packet id is issued.
Command packets may not become the durable legal source of operator intent.

message_family_rows.durable_truth_anchor: Manifest stage receipt and durable execution claim ledger
message_family_rows.transport_boundary: Workers claim stage work from durable receipts; broker redelivery only replays the same stage claim.
notes: A duplicate stage packet may only reuse the same durable execution claim or surface a finished result.
Balanced reduction and frozen inputs still bind the worker after publication.

message_family_rows.durable_truth_anchor: Object-version receipt plus artifact processing ledger
message_family_rows.transport_boundary: Object-store notifications are at-least-once transport hints and must collapse onto one immutable object-version ledger row.
notes: Packet redelivery never licenses a second scan, preview, or evidence-binding mutation for the same immutable object version.
If the broker disappears, restore replays durable object-version and inbox truth rather than provider event history.

message_family_rows.transport_boundary: Transport retries reuse duplicate meaning from the sealed request identity; request hash still proves the exact send basis.
notes: Lawful token rotation within the same frozen binding lineage preserves duplicate meaning and idempotency while changing request hash.
A namespace collision is a hard block even when payload bytes match.

message_family_rows.transport_boundary: Callbacks and recovery observations enter through authenticated ingress receipts before they can influence settlement truth.
notes: Missing or stale source-record continuity on inbox arrival must quarantine before any mutation.
Authenticated ingress proof and canonical ingress receipt refs survive restore and duplicate delivery.

source_lineage.rationale: The engine requires a transactional outbox for publication and a transactional inbox or dedupe gate before any mutation.
Queue rebuild comes from durable outbox, inbox, interaction, and receipt truth rather than broker backlog.
Authority duplicate meaning, request hash, and idempotency derive from the sealed request identity rather than packet-local metadata.
